summary: This Form 6-K reports the results of Standard Lithium Ltd.'s Annual General and Special Meeting held July 16, 2026. Shareholders voted on routine matters: setting the number of directors at nine, electing all nine director nominees (each with over 99% support), appointing PricewaterhouseCoopers as auditor (98.92% for), and re-approving the stock option plan (88.13% for) and long-term incentive plan (93.91% for). No extraordinary special-situation event—merger, acquisition, tender offer, activist campaign, or similar—occurred. This is a routine regulatory filing of meeting results, not a triggering special situation.
